summary: Enhance your skills with our Anti-Money Laundering and Financial Crime Prevention Course. Learn essential strategies to combat financial crime effectively.
lede: The Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF) Compliance course helps you turn risk identification into demonstrable controls across onboarding, monitoring, investigation, reporting, and remediation. You will learn to assess customers and beneficial owners, recognize meaningful indicators, investigate unusual activity, and document escalation decisions with traceable evidence. Practical exercises cover enterprise-wide risk assessments, customer risk-rating models, due diligence records, sanctions and politically exposed person screening, transaction-monitoring alerts, SAR/STR decision rationales, control testing, and KPI dashboards. The course also addresses incomplete data, legacy systems, false positives, limited investigation capacity, privacy constraints, and AI-assisted tools through proportionate, defensible workflows rather than technical engineering.
audienceIntro: This AML and CTF compliance course is designed for professionals who operate, oversee, test, or support financial crime controls. It suits foundation-level learners and experienced staff seeking a more structured risk-based workflow.
modules: FATF AML and CTF Compliance Foundations
AML and CTF Compliance Risk Assessment
AML and CTF Customer Due Diligence
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Basic familiarity with customer onboarding, payments, compliance, audit, risk, or financial operations is helpful. Prior specialist AML experience is optional because the course begins with foundation concepts before moving into intermediate application. Coding requirement: Coding and programming are not required. You should bring a laptop capable of opening spreadsheet files and viewing dashboard demonstrations; any browser or software preparation will be confirmed before delivery. Content depth: Risk assessment, customer due diligence, alert investigation, control testing, and roadmap development receive hands-on operational treatment. AI-assisted verification, machine-learning anomaly scoring, and advanced monitoring architecture receive conceptual awareness and operational application.
